title: The conductor ideal of normalization commutes with smooth pullback
statement:
Let $S$ be a reduced scheme of finite type over $\mathbf Q$ [def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $
u:S^
u	o S$ be its componentwise normalization [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. The map $
u$ is finite, the map $\mathcal O_S	o
u_*\mathcal O_{S^
u}$ is injective, and its cokernel $C_S$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module. Define $D_S=\operatorname{Ann}_{\mathcal O_S}(C_S)$, where a local section $a$ belongs to the annihilator if multiplication by $a$ on every local section of $C_S$ is zero. Then $D_S$ is a coherent ideal, and $V(D_S)$ is precisely the set of points whose local ring is not an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. This zero set is nowhere dense; $D_S=\mathcal O_S$ if and only if $S$ is normal. For every smooth $h:T	o S$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], $D_T=D_S\mathcal O_T$ as ideals in $\mathcal O_T$. This equality is compatible with identities and composition.
